shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin price dropped below $62,000 causing over $1.6 billion in liquidations.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced a record 20-day streak of outflows totaling $4.4 billion.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has dropped to 11, indicating extreme fear in the market.
Rising US-Iran tensions and higher than expected CPI data are dampening risk appetite and delaying potential Federal Reserve rate cuts.
Standard Chartered suggests that the current Bitcoin price level presents a buying opportunity.
